Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 11
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that Edward I’s mother was “Eleanor of Castile,” confusing Edward I’s wife with his mother, Eleanor of Provence. This misidentification occurred immediately after viewing the Britannica page that explicitly linked Eleanor of Provence to “son Edward I,” and the Planner even propagated the wrong name in the return instructions, making it the first and primary source of the incorrect solution.
